# I-96 Home Buyers

> I-96 Home Buyers pays cash for homes in Grand Rapids, Michigan and all of West Michigan. We make fair, no-obligation cash offers within 24 hours and can close in as little as 7 days. No repairs, no agent fees, no commissions.

## About

I-96 Home Buyers is a local cash home buying company based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, owned and operated by Ronnie Walker. Ronnie has been buying homes in West Michigan for over 13 years. The company was founded to make selling a house simple, fast, and fair for homeowners who need to sell quickly without the hassle of traditional real estate listings.

## What We Do

- Buy houses for cash in Grand Rapids, MI and surrounding West Michigan communities
- Make fair cash offers within 24 hours of inquiry
- Purchase homes in any condition — no repairs, cleaning, or staging required
- Close in as little as 7 days, or on the seller's preferred timeline
- Charge zero fees, commissions, or closing costs to the seller

## Who We Help

Homeowners facing any of the following situations:
- Inherited properties they don't want to manage
- Foreclosure or pre-foreclosure
- Divorce and need to sell quickly
- Relocation for work or family
- Tired landlords done with tenants
- Homes needing major repairs or full rehab
- Vacant or distressed properties

## Service Area

Grand Rapids, Wyoming, Kentwood, Walker, Grandville, and all of West Michigan.

## How It Works

1. Fill out the form or call with the property address and basic details
2. Receive a fair, no-obligation cash offer within 24 hours
3. Choose a closing date — close as fast as 7 days and receive cash
